answer: In an agent economy serving meadow farms, karst quarries, and delta ports, each bidding identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving one daily auction entry. Creating 1,000 fake identities therefore ties up $100,000 for a month; splitting the same funds across more names buys no extra entries. Access scales with locked capital, making each additional sybil carry the same funding cost as a legitimate participant.
